**This issue is public.** Do not include credentials, exploit payloads, private logs/paths, publisher feeds, user/payment records or private correspondence. For a vulnerability or suspected secret, stop and use [private security reporting](https://github.com/dmoliveira/wrap-brief/security/advisories/new). Do not attach unreviewed logs or screenshots.

## Expected and actual behavior

Describe the non-sensitive difference. State the component and commit/version if known.

## Minimal synthetic reproduction

Use hand-authored data and reserved example domains. Give small safe steps, not a raw feed, full environment dump or private trace. If reproduction requires sensitive information, do not submit it here.

## Relevant checks

Name commands and bounded pass/fail summaries. Do not paste tokens, headers, credentials, machine paths or private logs.
